More than 50 Years of Excellence

GACL, a leader in the Chlor-Alkali sector, was established in 1973 in Vadodara, the cultural city of Gujarat. GACL has emerged as a shining beacon of self-reliance and an indispensable contributor to the industrial and economic growth of Gujarat and India as a whole. Our journey, nurtured under the auspices of the Government of Gujarat, has been marked by an unwavering dedication to cutting-edge technology, pioneering research and development, and strategic diversification.

As one of the foremost Chlor-Alkali manufacturers, our path mirrors India's remarkable progress. From our origins in caustic soda production, we have expanded to provide over 35 top-tier products. Our commitment to operational excellence aligns with global standards, ensuring our products touch and improve every aspect of life, every day.

GACL stands out in the chemical manufacturing industry, driven by a diverse and dynamic product portfolio. What truly sets us apart is our unwavering commitment to sustainability and eco-friendliness. We take great pride in pioneering eco-friendly technologies, upholding rigorous safety and quality standards, and maintaining our social responsibility. At GACL, we consistently lead the way, making a profound and enduring impact on society to build a better world for future generations.
Our commitment to sustainability is deeply ingrained in our DNA. Our steadfast dedication to environmental responsibility propels our all-inclusive progress.

Safety and Health are of utmost significance to us. It encompasses a multitude of facets right from the management to employees, contract workers, the workplace, the environment, and the community at large.
At GACL, we recognize the profound influence that businesses can exert on society. Consequently, social responsibility is not merely a duty; it is ingrained in our core values.

Our association with GACL has been very progressive and the one, which is a win-win for both the partners. The transparent, committed, and disciplined management not only makes business dealings smooth but also helps explore new opportunities to develop and strengthen business. We value GACLs association and endeavour to nurture this partnership for mutual betterment. Highly dependable Supply Chain partner towards consistent in quality and delivery. The journey began few years ago has transformed into collaboration for Safety & Sustainability initiatives. Wish all the Success to GACL in future endeavours !
